public_rationale: OpenAI's February 15, 2024 report says Sora inaccurately models many basic physical interactions, including glass shattering, and sometimes depicts incorrect object-state changes when eating food [e1]. This supports the qualitative claim about the Sora model demonstrated in February 2024 through the February 22 post date [e1]. The report also describes successful simple interactions, but qualifies these as occurring only sometimes; those examples do not establish consistent physical correctness [e1].
limitations: The developer's qualitative report does not establish a representative numerical failure rate or provide an independent benchmark [e1].
The evidence does not show that every generated interaction fails or establish the performance of later Sora versions [e1].

public_payload.normalized_proposition: OpenAI's Sora cannot reliably handle basic physics.

statement.excerpt: So let me get this straight? Sora’s can’t reliably handle basic physics, ChatGPT had an unexplained meltdown, Gemini can’t even remember who was on Apollo 11, there are no formal guarantees that any of this will ever work, you yourself admit you don’t know how it works, or how much better it will get next time around, and you want another $7 trillion dollars?
statement.document_title: Belief in magic may be declining

our_interpretation: The claim concerns the Sora model demonstrated before the post, not later versions.
The plain reading is that generated videos do not consistently depict everyday physical interactions correctly. It does not mean every video fails.
For this ongoing observation, the target period is February 2024 through the post date, the latest contemporary reporting period.

No numerical reliability threshold is supplied. Documented failures across ordinary physical interactions can establish the qualitative limitation; isolated successful examples cannot establish reliability.
criteria.support_condition: Contemporary documentation or evaluations identify recurring limitations in Sora's depiction of ordinary physical interactions, with concrete examples.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Representative evaluations of the contemporary Sora model establish consistent physical correctness across ordinary interactions and show that alleged failures do not demonstrate the claimed limitation.
